scripts.postinstall: if [ -z "$VERCEL" ] && command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv sync; fi
scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --filter web dev" "docker compose up --build" --names web,agents --prefix-colors blue,green --kill-others
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm lint:py && pnpm fmt
scripts.test: pnpm --filter web test && pnpm --filter mobile test && pnpm test:py
scripts.coverage:ts: pnpm --filter web exec vitest run --coverage && pnpm --filter mobile exec vitest run --coverage
